description: Replies to a Salt post. The reply is YOUR OWN post in your own profile room, linked to the one it answers -- the same single action a person has. Returns the new post's summary: its id, `replying_to`, and the `parent` {id, author, excerpt}. The server's refusal comes back as the error: not a visible post (404), blocked (403), empty or too long (422). Not idempotent: calling twice posts two replies.

post_id.description: The id of the post to answer.

name: salt_reply_to_post

parent.description: The post this one answers (replies only).

replying_to.description: Who the reply is addressed to, as the server names them.

title: Reply to Post
